p: shewed kindness unto me: The children of God are not unmindful of a benefit received.
to search the city: Their arrogant malice would not allow them to see the simplicity of David's heart: therefore their counsel turned to the destruction of their country.
stank before David: That they deserved David's displeasure, for the harm done to his ambassadors.
Zoba: These were various parts of the country of Syria, by which it appears that the Syrians served where they might have entertainment, as now the Sweitzers do.
our people: Here it is declared why war should be undertaken: for the defence of true religion and God's people.
all Israel together: Meaning, the greatest part.
seven hundred chariots of the Syrians: Who were the chief and most principal: for in all he destroyed 7000, as in 1Ch 19:18, or the soldiers who were in 700 chariots.
